 According to unofficial results from the Minnesota Secretary of State, Ilhan Omar will continue to serve Minnesota's Fifth District. 
 District 5 includes part or all of Minneapolis, Robbinsdale, Golden Valley, Crystal, New Hope, Fridley, Richfield, St. Louis Park, Brooklyn Center, Columbia Heights, Hilltop, Edina, St. Anthony and Spring Lake Park.
 U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar (D) faced challengers John Nagel (R) and DeVelle L. Jackson (I).
 Omar took home 77% of votes.
 Nagel received 16% of votes.
 Jackson received 7% votes.
